message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime based on facts: selling a forged "流动人口婚育证明" (migrant population marriage and childbirth certificate) for 30 yuan. This is forging official documents and selling them. In Chinese criminal law, crimes include "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪" (forgery of state documents) and "买卖国家机关证件、印章罪". Also "非法买卖国家机关证件罪". The act of selling a forged official document is "非法买卖国家机关证件罪" (selling forged official documents). Also could be "伪造国家机关证件罪". The person sold a forged document, not necessarily forged by him? He sold a forged document; he may be guilty of "伪造、变造国家机关证件罪" if he forged it, and "买卖国家机关证件罪" if he sold. The fact says "贩卖了一本伪造的...证明". It doesn't state he forged it, just sold it. So the crime is "买卖国家机关证件罪". In Chinese law, article 280 of Criminal Law: "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章的，或者买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役、管制或者罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑". So the appropriate charge: "买卖国家机关证件罪". So answer: [罪名]买卖国家机关证件罪<eoa>
